verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships a well-documented official Python async SDK (AsyncWebCrawler, arun()) with extensive first-party docs covering extraction, markdown generation, and browser control, plus an official CLI and MCP integration for AI tools. Community confirms real usage though notes it requires assembling production-grade policy/rate-limiting on top. Missing for 10: independent third-party SDK benchmarking/reviews beyond community forum comments, and no OpenAPI/other-language SDK evidence.
